author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: Kat
title: Looking for a human artist for paid short-story illustrations
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book. Looking for small black-and-white illustrations in a Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark vibe. DM for details.

author: Temmycreative
title: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid) Halloween hoodie design
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: One skeleton as the main character, Punk/rock retro horror vibe, Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS), Large back print (13” × 16”), Neon green, purple & orange palette, Original artwork only. Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Must be an adobe illustrator. Please dm if available.
